summary: Iteration 7 tested end-to-end: VIES NIF lookup, VeriFactu simulado + preproduccion modes, signed XML download, cert-expiry cron, and idempotency regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter7.py with 13 tests covering all iter7 endpoints. Ran full regression: 52/52 backend tests pass (test_iter7.py + backend_test.py + test_new_features.py + test_rectificativa.py + test_verifactu.py + test_verifactu_cert.py). Frontend UI verified: verifactu-mode selector saves both Simulado/Preproducción, lookup-nif button in Nueva Factura dialog calls /lookup/nif and toast shows 'VIES no facilita el nombre para este contribuyente; complétalo a mano.' for valid ES CIF with empty name, and Conexión log shows Simulado/Preprod badge + expandable request/response XML + 'Descargar XML firmado' button per entry.

issues: The static text 'Simulado (preproducción)' with amber pulse is misleading when the company mode is 'preproduccion' with a real cert - it always reads Simulado regardless of user's actual verifactu_mode. Consider reading verifactu_mode from /api/company and showing 'Preproducción (mTLS)' when preproduccion is selected.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Reflect actual company.verifactu_mode in the Conexión 'Estado del servicio' card instead of the hardcoded 'Simulado (preproducción)' label.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verifactu_submit correctly captures AEAT connection errors from send_to_aeat and stores them in response_xml as 'ERROR DE CONEXIÓN CON LA AEAT...' - preproduccion attempts do not 500 the API, verified.
verifactu_service.send_to_aeat correctly wraps httpx.AsyncClient with mTLS via temp PEM files and cleans them up in finally; timeout=20s prevents hanging.
lookup_nif normalizes NIF (strip, upper, remove spaces/dashes, drop leading ES) and gracefully returns 502 on VIES outage; empty NIF returns 400 as expected.
check_cert_expiry cron authenticates via hmac.compare_digest and offloads work to background task; idempotent per user (guarded by expiry_notified_for = valid_to_raw).
server.py has grown to 869 lines; splitting VeriFactu (submit, cert, log, xml, cron) into a router module would improve maintainability.
Idempotency of verifactu_submit (fixed in iter6) is now confirmed: second call short-circuits with already:true and does NOT insert a duplicate log entry.
test_credentials: admin@fiscalhub.es / admin123; WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env at test time
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral self-signed .pfx (TEST_ITER7_CN) generated in-test via cryptography.pkcs12 for preproduccion mTLS attempt. Test invoices are cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter7 backend endpoints (VIES /lookup/nif, PUT /company verifactu_mode, POST /invoices/{id}/verifactu/submit in simulado & preproduccion, GET /invoices/{id}/verifactu/xml, POST /cron/check-cert-expiry) verified. Regression covers full 52 tests. To run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/ -n 0`. Note pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; parallel workers can race on the shared admin company (verifactu_mode toggling between tests) — use `-n 0` for iter7 file. UI selectors verified: lookup-nif, verifactu-mode, save-company, connection-log, log-entry-{number}, download-xml-{number}. Preproduccion mode from this env cannot reach prewww1.aeat.es (as expected); the error is captured in log.response_xml and the API returns 200 with mode='preproduccion', simulated=false, estado='Error'.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in iteration 7.
